messages.subject: For Joaquin Duato | Global healthcare, government relations and stakeholder strategy
messages.body:
Dear Johnson & Johnson Investor Relations Team,

Please place this executive introduction before Mr. Joaquin Duato, Chairman and Chief Executive Officer.

Johnson & Johnson's global healthcare platform operates across governments, regulators, health systems, communities and major investment priorities. That stakeholder environment closely matches my current leadership mandate.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My responsibilities span government and regulatory relations, ESG, corporate affairs, strategic partnerships and executive advisory, with senior institutional engagement across complex regulated operations.

I would welcome a senior discussion about where this combination of government relations, ESG and stakeholder execution might support Johnson & Johnson's priorities. My attached CV has been tailored specifically to Johnson & Johnson.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
